name: E-2 Hawkeye
summary: Carrier-based twin-turboprop airborne early warning aircraft with a large rotating radar dome on top, flown from every US aircraft carrier.

wings: High-mounted straight wing that folds back along the fuselage on deck
Long-span wing relative to the short fuselage
engines: Large engine nacelles slung under the wing
fuselage: Short, stubby fuselage with a large flat radar disc (rotodome) on a pylon above
Tailhook and sturdy carrier landing gear
E-2D has a refueling probe over the cockpit on newer aircraft
tail: Four vertical fins on a dihedral horizontal tail
Wide tailplane spanning the rear of the fuselage

tellTales: Large disc radar above a small twin-turboprop
Four vertical fins on an upswept tailplane
Short, stubby fuselage with a high folding wing

confusedWith.howToTell: The E-2 is a small twin-turboprop with a four-fin tail; the E-3 is a large four-jet airliner with a single tall fin.
